chapter_title: Tissues: Division of Labor in Multicellular Organisms

m1_zero_omission_notes.chapter_executive_summary: Details plant tissues (meristematic: apical, lateral, intercalary; permanent: simple xylem/phloem) and animal tissues (epithelial, connective, muscular, nervous).

detailed_section_hierarchy.full_explanation: Meristematic tissues divide actively; permanent tissues specialize into parenchymal, collenchymal, sclerenchymal, and vascular conducting networks.

glossary_and_key_terms.definition: Actively dividing plant tissue responsible for growth.

m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.activity_or_procedure_title: Observing Root Growth in Onion Bulbs
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.objective_or_aim: Demonstrate growth driven by root apical meristem.
step_by_step_procedure: Cut root tips of jar 2 on day 4.
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.expected_observations_or_working: Jar 1 roots continue growing; Jar 2 roots stop growing.
m3_practical_activities_lab_and_step_by_.scientific_or_logical_conclusion: Removal of apical meristem halts length growth.

diagrams_and_illustrations.figure_title: Location of Meristematic Tissues in Plant Body
diagrams_and_illustrations.drawing_or_labeling_instructions: Draw shoot tip, stem nodes, and stem girth regions.
diagrams_and_illustrations.key_structural_details: Apical at tips, intercalary at nodes, lateral in vascular cambium.

scripted_dialogues.speaker: Teacher
scripted_dialogues.speech_text: How do collenchyma and sclerenchyma tissues differ in their cell wall structure and cell vitality?

scripted_dialogues.speaker: Student
scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Collenchyma consists of living cells with localized corner thickenings of pectin/cellulose for flexibility. Sclerenchyma consists of dead cells with thick, uniformly lignified walls for extreme rigidity!

scripted_dialogues.speaker: Teacher
scripted_dialogues.speech_text: Spot on. That is why coconut husks made of sclerenchyma are so tough.
